## Evidence / validation
Commands run, observed results, screenshots if useful, and untested boundaries:

## Checklist
- [ ] Focused scope, with related issue/roadmap item where applicable
- [ ] Relevant tests pass and actual changed workflow was exercised
- [ ] No credentials, private data or third-party game assets
- [ ] Authored data stays in sheets and upstream notices are preserved
- [ ] Mobile/keyboard and error states checked for UI changes
- [ ] Asset release version / public allowlist updated if needed
- [ ] Documentation and limitations reflect what really works
